from itertools import product

# Single-work model. Variables:
# contemporary, centuries (pleases for centuries), objective (can be objectively judged great),
# lifetime_diverge (evaluations differed in the creator's lifetime),
# eras_differ (evaluations differ across eras), unanimous (critics unanimous now), great
VARS = ["contemporary", "centuries", "objective", "lifetime_diverge",
        "eras_differ", "unanimous", "great"]

def premises(w):
    # Subjective in a short period: a contemporary work can't be objectively judged yet.
    if w["contemporary"] and w["objective"]:
        return False
    # Pleasing for centuries -> objectively judged great.
    if w["centuries"] and not (w["objective"] and w["great"]):
        return False
    # A work can't be both contemporary and centuries-old.
    if w["contemporary"] and w["centuries"]:
        return False
    # "Often diverges" is a tendency, so it forces nothing about any particular work.
    # The "subjective element gradually disappears" claim also forces no era difference.
    return True

options = {
    "A": lambda w: w["lifetime_diverge"],                  # evaluations differed in the creator's lifetime
    "B": lambda w: (not w["contemporary"]) or (not w["objective"]),  # contemporary -> not objectively determinable
    "C": lambda w: w["eras_differ"],                       # evaluations differ strongly across eras
    "D": lambda w: (not (w["contemporary"] and w["unanimous"])) or w["great"],
}

worlds = [dict(zip(VARS, vals)) for vals in product([False, True], repeat=len(VARS))]
models = [w for w in worlds if premises(w)]
print("worlds:", len(worlds), "models of premises:", len(models))

results = {}
for name, f in options.items():
    cex = next((w for w in models if not f(w)), None)
    results[name] = cex is None
    print(name, "entailed (exhaustive over finite model):", cex is None)
    if cex:
        print("   counterexample:", {k: v for k, v in cex.items() if v})

claimed = "B"
only_b = results["B"] and not any(results[k] for k in "ACD")
print("Claimed:", claimed, "| B entailed:", results["B"], "| A,C,D not entailed:",
      not any(results[k] for k in "ACD"))
print("CHECK PASS" if only_b else "CHECK FAIL")
